summary: iter30: Tested 4 new features end-to-end. Backend: 17/17 pytest passed covering (a) admin-users access control (superadmin-only for GET/POST/PUT/DELETE - non-auth=401, owner=403, super=200/list of 4 users); (b) PUT /api/auth/me self-profile update (name OK, password change with all validations: missing current=400, wrong current=400, short new=400, empty payload=400, no auth=401, new-pwd login works, re-login with old fails); (c) POST /api/fiscal/budgets/{id}/revoke on temp ACP cascades cleanly (status->draft, deleted_fund_calls field returned); (d) PUT /api/coproprietes/{id} edit preserves pcmn_number for bank_accounts on Demo ACP. Frontend: login as superadmin OK, sidebar shows nav-admin-users + nav-profile, ProfilePage exposes all 9 expected data-testids with email correctly displayed (admin@copro.be), AdminUsersPage lists exactly 4 users, edit-copro-{id} button visible with text 'Modifier' and opens dialog pre-filled with name='Test', BCE, address, etc. As syndic (non-superadmin): nav-admin-users HIDDEN, nav-profile visible, /admin/users page renders with the access-restricted banner, /profile fully accessible with Syndic badge.

issues: React a11y warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby={undefined} for {DialogContent}' on multiple dialogs - non-blocking but should add DialogDescription for screen readers

critical_code_review_comments: Backend role helpers are well separated: is_admin_role (data access) vs is_superadmin_only (platform user mgmt). All /api/admin/users CRUD routes correctly call _get_superadmin_only.
PUT /api/auth/me correctly re-fetches password_hash from DB (since get_current_user pops it). Validation order is correct: length>=6, current_password required, verify_password, then hash.

Budget revoke endpoint properly cascades via _delete_auto_entries(db, 'fund_call', c['id']) for every linked call then bulk-deletes fund_calls; force=true also un-letters bank_transactions. Returns updated budget + counters.

Layout.js: 'Utilisateurs' link is conditioned by isSuperadmin in BOTH layouts (sidebar AND top header for no-ACP). 'Mon profil' is unconditional. AdminUsersPage banner correctly rendered for non-superadmin via the !isSuperadmin branch.
Minor a11y: Several DialogContent (Edit ACP, others) miss DialogDescription/aria-describedby - emits console warnings.
ProfilePage uses sonner toasts and forces re-login after password change (logout()), which matches the banner displayed in UI.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all expected data-testids present, RBAC enforced, dialog opens with pre-filled values)

test_credentials: admin@copro.be / admin123 (superadmin). Test owner/syndic users created via POST /api/admin/users and cleaned up.
seed_data_creation: Created and cleaned up: TEST_iter30_owner_* user, TEST_iter30_syndic_* user, TEST_iter30_acp_* temp ACP (with FY2099 + budget). Demo ACP description was temporarily modified for the edit test then restored. No persistent test data left behind.
